title: MultiModel Dev OS Plugin Schema
description: JSON schema reference detailing declarative plugin metadata and permitted directories configuration

slug.description: Unique URL-friendly slug representing the plugin

version.description: Semantic versioning number of the plugin (e.g. 1.0.0)

description.description: Brief summary of what capabilities and templates this plugin introduces

author.description: Name of the developer or team who created the plugin

allowed_file_patterns.description: Target paths inside .ai/ or adapters/ this plugin is permitted to write to

denied_file_patterns.description: Explicit blacklisted paths this plugin is blocked from writing to

templates.description: Custom templates mapped by the plugin configuration

workflows.description: Custom workflows mapped by the plugin configuration

adapters.description: Custom adapter settings mapped by the plugin configuration

safety_notes.description: Explicit security notices displayed to the user during installation
